status: Exploratory extension after inspecting support diagnostic; not preregistered confirmation
reason: Units and extraction match, but within-lineage expression support shifts remain; use existing raw expression file to distinguish cohort composition from cross-release same-model differences
scope: Intersect the 773 historical development ModelIDs with all 309 rows already in downloaded next_gen_expression.csv; compare all 30 expression genes and fixed 12 rules only
exclusions: No historical final identity outcomes, Sanger data, or response matrices; no new model selection or calibration
interpretation: Same ModelID across releases is a technical bridge, not independent validation. Distinct samples/culture/time/processing may differ, so this cannot by itself identify the causal source of shifts.
minimum_support_for_claim: Report whatever count is available; descriptive only, no significance claims
